bodies: American Institute of Certified Educational Planners
Substitute Teaching Division, Utah State University

exams.name: American Montessori Society Teacher Credential
exams.blurb: Montessori credential spanning infant-toddler through secondary levels, requiring academic coursework and a supervised practicum year.

exams.name: Association Montessori Internationale Teaching Diploma
exams.blurb: Montessori teaching diploma offered at assistants-to-infancy, primary, elementary and adolescent levels through AMI training centres.

exams.name: Certified Childcare Professional
exams.blurb: Alternative national early childhood credential based on training hours, a professional portfolio and an observed classroom assessment.

exams.name: Certified Educational Planner
exams.body: American Institute of Certified Educational Planners
exams.blurb: Credential for independent educational consultants advising on school and college placement, requiring experience, references and an examination.

exams.name: Child Development Associate — Family Child Care
exams.blurb: CDA setting for educators running home-based child care, assessed through a portfolio, verification visit and the CDA exam.

exams.name: Child Development Associate — Home Visitor
exams.blurb: CDA setting for staff who support child development through visits to family homes rather than in a centre-based classroom.

exams.name: Child Development Associate — Infant-Toddler
exams.blurb: National early childhood credential for educators of children from birth to three, requiring 120 training hours and a verification visit.

exams.name: Child Development Associate — Preschool
exams.blurb: Most common CDA setting, for educators of children aged three to five, assessed by portfolio, observation and a 65-item examination.

exams.name: Child Development Associate Bilingual Specialization
exams.blurb: Add-on specialisation to the Child Development Associate credential for educators delivering programmes in two languages.

exams.name: ParaPro Assessment
exams.blurb: Assessment of reading, writing and mathematics skills and their classroom application, used to qualify paraprofessionals under federal rules.

exams.name: Praxis ParaPathways: Mathematics (5759)
exams.blurb: Praxis mathematics test designed as an accessible entry route into educator preparation for paraeducators and career changers.

exams.name: Praxis ParaPathways: Reading and Writing (5758)
exams.blurb: Praxis literacy test offering an alternative basic-skills route for paraeducators entering teacher preparation programmes.

exams.name: STEDI Substitute Teacher Training and SubSkills Test
exams.body: Substitute Teaching Division, Utah State University
exams.blurb: Widely used national substitute teacher training programme ending in the SubSkills competency test, adopted by many districts.

exams.name: Praxis Braille Proficiency (0633)
exams.blurb: Paper-delivered test of literary braille reading and transcription for teachers of students with visual impairments.

exams.name: Praxis Gifted Education (5358)
exams.blurb: Endorsement test covering identification, curriculum differentiation, social-emotional needs and programme models for gifted learners.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Early Childhood/Early Intervention (5692)
exams.blurb: Test for early intervention specialists covering developmental assessment, family-centred services and individualised family service plans.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Education of Deaf and Hard of Hearing Students (5272)
exams.blurb: Test for teachers of deaf and hard of hearing students, covering audiology basics, communication modes, literacy and assistive technology.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Foundational Knowledge (5355)
exams.blurb: Core special education licensure test covering development, assessment, instruction, behaviour support and federal disability law.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Severe to Profound (5547)
exams.blurb: Test for teachers of students with severe and profound disabilities, covering communication systems, life skills and health care needs.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Speech to Students with Language Impairments (5881)
exams.blurb: Test for school-based speech and language educators covering articulation, language disorders, assessment and classroom collaboration.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Students with Behavioral Disorders and Emotional Disturbances (5372)
exams.blurb: Test covering functional behaviour assessment, positive behaviour supports and instruction for students with emotional and behavioural needs.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Students with Intellectual Disabilities (5322)
exams.blurb: Test covering functional curriculum, adaptive skills, transition planning and instruction for students with intellectual disabilities.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Students with Learning Disabilities (5383)
exams.blurb: Test covering identification, specialised instruction and accommodation strategies for students with specific learning disabilities.

exams.name: Praxis Special Education: Teaching Students with Visual Impairments (5282)
exams.blurb: Test for teachers of students with visual impairments, covering braille literacy, orientation and mobility and the expanded core curriculum.

exams.name: Praxis Agriculture (5701)
exams.blurb: Content test for agricultural education teachers, covering plant and animal science, agribusiness, mechanics and programme management.

exams.name: Praxis Business Education: Content Knowledge (5101)
exams.blurb: Content test for business education teachers covering accounting, economics, management, business law and information technology.

exams.name: Praxis Family and Consumer Sciences (5123)
exams.blurb: Current family and consumer sciences licensure test covering nutrition, human development, textiles, housing and resource management.

exams.name: Praxis Health and Physical Education: Content Knowledge (5857)
exams.blurb: Combined content test for candidates seeking licensure to teach both health education and physical education.

exams.name: Praxis Health Education (5551)
exams.blurb: Content test for health education teachers covering wellness, disease prevention, substance use, mental health and curriculum planning.

exams.name: Praxis Health Occupations (5052)
exams.blurb: Content test for teachers of secondary health science and health career pathway programmes in career and technical education.

exams.name: Praxis Marketing Education (5561)
exams.blurb: Content test for marketing education teachers, covering marketing functions, entrepreneurship, selling, promotion and work-based learning.

exams.name: Praxis Physical Education: Content and Design (5095)
exams.blurb: Physical education test combining content questions with constructed-response tasks on lesson design, assessment and programme planning.

exams.name: Praxis Physical Education: Content Knowledge (5091)
exams.blurb: Content test for physical education teachers covering movement skills, fitness, motor development, safety and instructional strategies.

exams.name: Praxis Technology and Engineering Education (5053)
exams.blurb: Current technology education licensure test covering design processes, manufacturing, energy, transportation and engineering practices.

exams.name: Praxis Algebra I (5162)
exams.blurb: Focused mathematics test for teachers whose licence is limited to Algebra I, covering expressions, equations, functions and modelling.

exams.name: Praxis Biology: Content Knowledge (5236)
exams.blurb: Secondary biology licensure test covering cells, genetics, evolution, organisms, ecology, and scientific inquiry and laboratory safety.

exams.name: Praxis Chemistry: Content Knowledge (5246)
exams.blurb: Secondary chemistry licensure test covering atomic structure, bonding, reactions, thermodynamics, solutions and laboratory practice.

exams.name: Praxis Computer Science (5652)
exams.blurb: Content test for computer science teachers covering programming, algorithms, data structures, computing systems and digital citizenship.

exams.name: Praxis Earth and Space Sciences: Content Knowledge (5572)
exams.blurb: Licensure test covering geology, meteorology, oceanography, astronomy and earth systems for secondary earth science teachers.

exams.name: Praxis General Science: Content Knowledge (5436)
exams.blurb: Broad science licensure test spanning physics, chemistry, biology and earth science plus scientific methodology and safety.

exams.name: Praxis Geometry (5163)
exams.blurb: Focused mathematics test on congruence, similarity, trigonometry, circles, measurement and geometric proof for geometry teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Mathematics: Content Knowledge (5165)
exams.blurb: Secondary mathematics licensure test covering number, algebra, functions, calculus, geometry, probability and statistics.

exams.name: Praxis Physical Science: Content Knowledge (5485)
exams.blurb: Combined physics and chemistry licensure test for candidates teaching general physical science at the secondary level.

exams.name: Praxis Physics: Content Knowledge (5266)
exams.blurb: Current secondary physics licensure test covering mechanics, electricity and magnetism, waves, thermodynamics and modern physics.

exams.name: Performance Assessment for School Leaders
exams.blurb: Portfolio-based leadership assessment in which aspiring principals document problem solving, teacher support and data-driven decisions.

exams.name: Praxis Audiology (5343)
exams.blurb: National audiology examination used for state licensure and the ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence in audiology.

exams.name: Praxis Educational Leadership: Administration and Supervision (5412)
exams.blurb: Principal licensure test covering vision, instructional leadership, school culture, management, ethics and community engagement.

exams.name: Praxis Professional School Counselor (5422)
exams.blurb: Licensure test for school counselors covering counseling, consultation, programme delivery, data use and professional practice.

exams.name: Praxis Reading Specialist (5302)
exams.blurb: Test for reading specialists and literacy coaches, covering assessment, intervention, curriculum leadership and professional learning.

exams.name: Praxis School Librarian (5312)
exams.blurb: Licensure test for school librarians covering collection development, information literacy instruction, technology and programme administration.

exams.name: Praxis School Psychologist (5403)
exams.blurb: National school psychology test required for the NCSP credential and for certification in many states, aligned to NASP practice domains.

exams.name: Praxis Speech-Language Pathology (5331)
exams.blurb: National examination used for state licensure and the ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence in speech-language pathology.

exams.name: School Leaders Licensure Assessment (6990)
exams.blurb: Principal licensure assessment based on national leadership standards, combining selected-response items with constructed-response scenarios.

exams.name: School Superintendent Assessment (6991)
exams.blurb: District leadership assessment for aspiring superintendents, covering governance, finance, human capital and system-wide instructional leadership.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School English Language Arts (5047)
exams.blurb: Middle grades English test covering reading, literature, writing, language and the teaching of literacy to young adolescents.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School Mathematics (5164)
exams.blurb: Middle grades mathematics licensure test covering ratios, expressions, equations, geometry, statistics and probability.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School Science (5442)
exams.blurb: Middle grades science licensure test covering life, physical and earth science along with science practices and safety.

exams.name: Praxis Middle School Social Studies (5089)
exams.blurb: Middle grades social studies test covering United States and world history, government, geography, economics and social science methods.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Early Childhood (5621)
exams.blurb: Pedagogy test for early childhood candidates combining case studies with questions on development, instruction and assessment.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Grades 5-9 (5623)
exams.blurb: Middle grades pedagogy test covering adolescent development, instructional planning, assessment and professional responsibilities.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Grades 7-12 (5624)
exams.blurb: Secondary pedagogy test combining case histories with questions on learners, instruction, assessment and professional practice.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: Grades K-6 (5622)
exams.blurb: Elementary pedagogy test covering child development, instructional strategies, assessment and communication with families.

exams.name: Praxis Principles of Learning and Teaching: PreK-12 (5625)
exams.blurb: All-grades pedagogy test for candidates whose licence spans preschool through grade twelve, such as art, music and world languages.

exams.name: Praxis Chinese (Mandarin): World Language (5665)
exams.blurb: Mandarin teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus presentational speaking and writing tasks.

exams.name: Praxis English to Speakers of Other Languages (5362)
exams.blurb: ESOL licensure test covering language acquisition, linguistics, instructional planning, assessment and cultural and professional issues.

exams.name: Praxis French: World Language (5174)
exams.blurb: French teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus recorded speaking and written presentational tasks.

exams.name: Praxis German: World Language (5183)
exams.blurb: German teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus presentational speaking and writing performance.

exams.name: Praxis Japanese: World Language (5661)
exams.blurb: Japanese teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading alongside presentational speaking and writing tasks.

exams.name: Praxis Latin (5601)
exams.blurb: Latin teacher licensure test covering reading comprehension of classical texts, grammar, Roman culture and language pedagogy.

exams.name: Praxis Russian: World Language (5671)
exams.blurb: Russian teacher licensure test assessing interpretive listening and reading plus presentational speaking and writing performance.

exams.name: Praxis Spanish: World Language (5195)
exams.blurb: The most widely taken Praxis world language test, assessing interpretive, presentational speaking and writing skills in Spanish.

exams.name: Praxis World Languages Pedagogy (5841)
exams.blurb: Language-neutral pedagogy test on communicative instruction, assessment, culture integration and technology in world language classrooms.

exams.name: Praxis Communication and Literacy Combined (5753)
exams.blurb: Combined literacy screening test made up of the reading and writing subtests, used by states requiring a communication skills measure.

exams.name: Praxis Communication and Literacy: Reading (5714)
exams.blurb: Reading comprehension subtest of the Praxis communication and literacy battery for prospective educators.

exams.name: Praxis Communication and Literacy: Writing (5724)
exams.blurb: Writing subtest of the Praxis communication and literacy battery, combining usage questions with two written essay tasks.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Combined (5752)
exams.blurb: Single sitting combining the reading, writing and mathematics Core subtests, the usual entry requirement for teacher preparation programmes.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Mathematics (5733)
exams.blurb: Basic mathematics skills test covering number, algebra, geometry, statistics and probability at the level expected of entering teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Reading (5713)
exams.blurb: Reading skills test for prospective teachers, measuring key ideas, craft and structure, and integration of knowledge across passages.

exams.name: Praxis Core Academic Skills for Educators: Writing (5723)
exams.blurb: Writing skills test combining grammar and usage questions with argumentative and source-based essay tasks for entering teachers.

exams.name: Praxis Fundamental Subjects: Content Knowledge (5511)
exams.blurb: Broad content test across English, mathematics, science and social studies, often used to add or verify multi-subject teaching authority.
